Name: ACRME Consumer Compute Operator
Description: G-14 CLOSURE ROLE (Tier 3). Customer-consented, resource-group-scoped rights to change VM-to-CRG association and, only as Path A fallback, deallocate/start a VM in an EXPLICIT consumer resource group. Deliberately narrow: no VM create/delete, no subscription-wide compute mutation, no networking or disk changes. This role is DISABLED by default and only assigned per incident with a recorded consent artifact and a tested revocation procedure. Until security approves this role, Tier 3 remains blocked.
